title: Key bindings
description: Every key of the terminal UI and the desktop app, generated from their keymaps.

<!-- Generated by website/scripts/gen-keys.ts from `mp dump-keys --json` (mailypoppins 0.11.0) and clients/desktop/src/keymap/catalog.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `pnpm gen:keys`. -->

The terminal UI and the desktop app share one keymap.
Press <kbd>?</kbd> in either to see it, or <kbd>:</kbd> to run any action by name from the command palette.
Keys come in mnemonic families: <kbd>c</kbd> compose, <kbd>t</kbd> thread and attachments, <kbd>f</kbd> find, <kbd>s</kbd> sync and settings, <kbd>g</kbd> go to.
Press a family key alone and a popup lists what can follow it.

Two letters in a row, such as <kbd>c</kbd><kbd>n</kbd>, are pressed one after the other.
`mp dump-keys` prints the terminal table outside the app.

## Desktop app

The app takes its keys from the same keymap.
The tables below list what the app runs today, with the app's own key where it binds another.
A few keys differ: <kbd>F</kbd> fetches a server-only search hit, since <kbd>f</kbd> starts the find family, and <kbd>t</kbd><kbd>t</kbd> switches the reader between HTML and plain text, since the app has no thread view yet.
The macOS menus run the same actions, and <kbd>Cmd+,</kbd> opens Settings.

### Command palette only

These actions have no key. Run them from the palette (<kbd>:</kbd> or <kbd>Ctrl+p</kbd>).

- Widen list
- Narrow list
- Restart daemon
- Add account
- Theme: dark
- Theme: light
- Theme: system
- Check for updates
- Cancel the server search
- Show intercepted links
- Reader: HTML
- Reader: text
- Copy sender address
- Copy subject
- Dismiss all notices
- New invitation

### Not in the desktop app yet

These terminal UI actions have no desktop equivalent so far.

- Message (list, headers, body): Show conversation (thread)
- Email list: Jump to date (e.g. last week)
- Email list: Show flagged only (toggle)
- Server search: Open in the mail list
- Server search: Open read-only in $EDITOR
- Server search: Copy the Markdown rendition path
- Server search: Reply / Reply-all
- Server search: Forward
- Server search: Switch focus
- Server search: Close overlay
